judged_text: sendAddGuestsEmails called with raw guests instead of uniqueGuests, causing wrong template selection for pre-existing attendees

record.issue_text: sendAddGuestsEmails called with raw guests instead of uniqueGuests, causing wrong template selection for pre-existing attendees

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler computes `uniqueGuests` (filtering out emails already in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted ones) and only persists those (`createMany` uses `guestsFullDetails` built from `uniqueGuests`). However it later calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` with the original raw `guests` input. In `sendAddGuestsEmails`, template selection depends on `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)`: attendees whose email is present in the passed list are treated as “new” and get `AttendeeScheduledEmail`, otherwise they get `AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`. Passing raw `guests` can incorrectly mark pre-existing attendees (entered again in the dialog) as “new”, causing wrong email template selection.
